text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Downloads(y, x) ::: y downloads x.
Shares(y, x) ::: y shares x.
Show(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Karen(x) ::: x is Karen.
BlackMirror(x) ::: x is "Black Mirror".
Premises:
Show("Stranger Things") ::: "Stranger Things" is a Netflix show.
∀x (Show(x) → (Popular(x) → BingeWatch(x, Karen))) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) ↔ Downloads(Karen, x)) ::: Karen binge-watches a show if and only if she downloads it.
¬Downloads(Karen, "Black Mirror") ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
Show("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Shares(Karen, x)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a show, she shares it to Lisa.
Conclusion:
Popular("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is popular.
